prompts.name: Let’s start your application. What is your full name?
prompts.dateOfBirth: What is your date of birth? Please use YYYY-MM-DD.
prompts.address: What is your address? You can say ‘skip’ if you do not have one yet.
prompts.gender: What is your gender: male or female?
prompts.photo: Thank you. Now I need a photo for your application.
prompts.review: I will read your application back, including the photo. Is this correct?
prompts.correction: Which answer would you like to fix: name, date of birth, address, gender, or where you come from?
